Bash(node -e "const {z}=require\('zod'\); console.log\('email:',typeof z.email, '| url:',typeof z.url, '| enum:',typeof z.enum\); const s=z.object\({a:z.email\(\),b:z.url\(\)}\); const r=s.safeParse\({a:'x@y.com',b:'https://a.com'}\); console.log\('ok:',r.success\); const bad=s.safeParse\({a:'nope',b:'nope'}\); console.log\('issues path/msg:', bad.error.issues.map\(i=>i.path+':'+i.message\)\); const en=z.enum\(['ms','en']\); console.log\('enum ok:', en.safeParse\('ms'\).success\);")

Bash(node -e "const {z}=require\('zod'\); const locales=Object.freeze\(['ms','en']\); const en=z.enum\(locales\); console.log\('readonly enum:', en.safeParse\('en'\).success\); const shape=Object.fromEntries\(locales.map\(l=>[l,z.string\(\).min\(1\)]\)\); const lt=z.object\(shape\); console.log\('localized ok:', lt.safeParse\({ms:'a',en:'b'}\).success, '| missing:', lt.safeParse\({ms:'a'}\).success\);")

Bash(node -e "const {z}=require\('zod'\); console.log\('z.iso:', typeof z.iso, '| z.iso.date:', z.iso && typeof z.iso.date\); try{console.log\('date ok:', z.iso.date\(\).safeParse\('2026-07-01'\).success, '| bad:', z.iso.date\(\).safeParse\('nope'\).success\);}catch\(e\){console.log\('ERR', e.message\);}")
